object.definition: The current action set $\mathcal D_t\subseteq\{x\in\mathbb R^d:\|x\|_2\le L\}$ may depend on the past but is revealed before action selection. The fixed unknown parameter satisfies $\|\theta_*\|_2\le S$. The source regret normalization requires every admissible action's mean reward to have absolute value at most $1$. $$Y_t=\langle x_t,\theta_*\rangle+\eta_t,\qquad |\langle x,\theta_*\rangle|\le1\quad(x\in\mathcal D_t).$$ $$\mathbb E\!\left[e^{\lambda\eta_t}\mid\mathcal F_{t-1},x_t\right]\le e^{\lambda^2\sigma^2/2}\quad(\lambda\in\mathbb R).$$

operation.query_signature: Observe $\mathcal D_t$, choose $x_t\in\mathcal D_t$, and receive the scalar reward $Y_t$. Causal randomized policies may solve the optimistic maximization problem over the current action set exactly. Inputs $L,S,\sigma,d,\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ are public and $\theta_*$ is hidden; the horizon need not be known in advance. Noise satisfies the conditional moment-generating-function bound and may be a martingale difference. I.i.d. Gaussian noise is a special case. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

steps: The learner observes $\mathcal D_t$, chooses $x_t\in\mathcal D_t$, and then receives the scalar reward $Y_t$.

Causal randomized policies may solve the optimistic maximization problem over the current action set exactly. Inputs $L,S,\sigma,d,\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ are public and $\theta_*$ hidden. Advance knowledge of the horizon is not required.
Noise satisfies a conditional moment-generating-function bound and may be a martingale difference. IID Gaussian noise is only a subclass.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.
protocols.adversary_information: Follow the model and oracle timing. Current private random realizations are not visible to the environment.
protocols.loss_bearing_points: The output is the complete action trajectory satisfying feasibility and timing requirements. Randomized mixtures may be implemented before acting. Retrospective averages or convex combinations cannot replace actions that have already incurred loss. No additional optimal value or certificate is required.
protocols.past_requery: History may be stored. New information from old samples or past rounds is unavailable unless the native interface explicitly permits it.
